component.name: FetchTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "run" end sub
function getJson(url as string) as object x = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") x.SetUrl(url) x.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") x.InitClientCertificates() x.EnableEncodings(true) body = x.GetToString() if body = "" then return invalid return ParseJson(body) end function
function describe(code as integer) as string if code = 0 then return "Clear" if code <= 2 then return "Partly cloudy" if code = 3 then return "Cloudy" if code <= 48 then return "Fog" if code <= 57 then return "Drizzle" if code <= 67 then return "Rain" if code <= 77 then return "Snow" if code <= 82 then return "Showers" if code <= 86 then return "Snow showers" return "Storms" end function
sub run() cfg = ParseJson(ReadAsciiFile("pkg:/config.json")) server = cfg.server lastWeather = -1000 tick = 0 while true s = getJson(server + "/api/scene") if s = invalid if m.top.error = "" then m.top.error = "Can't reach SaverSwap at " + server + ". Is that computer on?" else if m.top.error <> "" then m.top.error = "" if s.video = invalid if m.top.setup <> s.setup_url then m.top.setup = s.setup_url else if m.top.setup <> "" then m.top.setup = "" if s.video <> m.top.video then m.top.video = s.video end if o = s.overlay if o <> invalid if (o.clock = true) <> m.top.clock then m.top.clock = (o.clock = true) if (o.sound = true) <> m.top.sound then m.top.sound = (o.sound = true) if o.weather = true if tick - lastWeather >= 90 url = "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=" + Str(o.lat).Trim() + "&longitude=" + Str(o.lon).Trim() + "&current=temperature_2m,weather_code&temperature_unit=" + o.units w = getJson(url) if w <> invalid and w.current <> invalid t = Int(w.current.temperature_2m + 0.5) m.top.weather = t.ToStr() + Chr(176) + " " + describe(w.current.weather_code) lastWeather = tick end if end if else if m.top.weather <> "" m.top.weather = "" lastWeather = -1000 end if end if end if sleep(10000) tick = tick + 1 end while end sub
